Core Parameters

fraction

The proportion of data used for each local fit. Most important parameter.

Value Effect Use Case
0.1–0.3 Fine detail Rapidly changing signals
0.3–0.5 Balanced General purpose
0.5–0.7 Heavy smoothing Noisy data
0.7–1.0 Very smooth Trend extraction 
library(rfastlowess)
set.seed(42)
x <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 100)
y <- sin(x) + rnorm(100, sd = 0.3)

model <- Lowess(fraction = 0.3)
result <- fit(model, x, y)

iterations

Number of robustness iterations. Each iteration downweights high-residual points.

model <- Lowess(iterations = 3)
result <- fit(model, x, y)

degree

Polynomial degree for local fits: 0 (constant), 1 (linear, default), or 2 (quadratic).

model <- Lowess(degree = 2L)
result <- fit(model, x, y)

delta

Distance threshold for skipping intermediate points (approximation). Setting delta > 0 speeds up computation on dense grids. Passed as a fraction of the data range.

model <- Lowess(delta = 0.01)
result <- fit(model, x, y)

parallel

Enable parallel CPU execution (multiple cores).

model <- Lowess(parallel = TRUE)
result <- fit(model, x, y)

return_diagnostics

Return goodness-of-fit diagnostics (R², residuals, etc.).

model <- Lowess(return_diagnostics = TRUE)
result <- fit(model, x, y)
print(result$diagnostics$r_squared)

Streaming Parameters

chunk_size and overlap 

model <- StreamingLowess(
    chunk_size = 5000,
    overlap = 500,
    merge_strategy = "weighted_average"
)

Online Parameters

window_capacity and min_points 

model <- OnlineLowess(
    window_capacity = 50,
    min_points = 5,
    update_mode = "incremental"
)
